title: Hanford tank retrieval: Tank A-102 becomes the 23rd completed retrieval
publisher: U.S. Department of Energy, Office of Environmental Management
summary: DOE reports about 41,000 gallons transferred from single-shell Tank A-102 to a double-shell tank, bringing cumulative retrieved waste across 23 tanks to about 3.4 million gallons. Denominator: Completed Hanford single-shell tank retrievals through Tank A-102 and DOE's cumulative retrieved-gallon total as of May 1, 2026.
